column1: # gate-map.tsv — which class each repo path belongs to, for per-diff online spec selection.
# Format: <glob> TAB <class>. One glob per row; `#` starts a comment line. Globs use bash
# `case` semantics, so `*` also crosses `/` and there is no brace alternation. FIRST MATCH
# WINS: specific rows first, the catch-alls (`session/*`, `probe_api/*`, `e2e/specs/*`) last.
# Each class's required online specs live in scripts/gate-policy.tsv.
# Gated roots: src-tauri/src, src-tauri/resources/samples, e2e/specs, e2e/fixtures. A file
# under a gated root that matches no row is UNCLASSIFIED: `gates.sh --required-online`
# requires every canonical online spec for it (fail closed), and the Rust gate
# `every_gated_file_matches_a_gate_map_row` (fixture_gates.rs) fails naming it. A file elsewhere that
# matches no row is class none. A row that matches no file yet is legal.
# ── offline-oracle: unit tests and offline-only fixtures (before every catch-all) ──
# The session's transport set: only these files touch `self.hid`, the clock or a literal
# pump window (`session/boundary_tests.rs` enforces it). A diff in any other session file
# that touches a wait primitive or a window const escalates to transport (`gates.sh`).
# The remote tier's socket transport and its audio client: e2e builds only, never reached by
# The device-and-capture seam every session open, re-amp capture, settle and Stop goes through.
# The typed errors whose kinds steer the connect, open-retry and cancel paths.
# ── scan: the startup backup scan runs in every UI spec ──
# read_song_list feeds the scan (backup_read.rs, commands/presets.rs) and read_song_presets
# the seed's import path (replace_inplace.rs), so the module holding them is scan.
# The probe's Songs CRUD and the strict song-list harvests (session/songs.rs) run before
# EVERY online spec, so the one spec that also drives the song edits covers them: songs.
# ── write: the seed's import path and every save ──
# live_preset_value/live_audio_graph run on the seed's import path before every online spec.
# ── unit-lane: the unit lane's own runner, judge and lock (the remote twin runs none) ──
# ── remote-runner: the remote twin's own runner and config (the unit runs neither) ──
# ── lane: the harness and seed every online run, unit or twin, goes through ──
# The one command list the e2e server (and the app) registers.
# ── probe-entry: online runs only its --seed-scenario arm ──
# ── level: Doctor and leveling share captures, so both specs run ──
# The Doctor check, and the leveller (its captures, loads, restores and saves). Doctor
# writes nothing, so no spec reads a Doctor save back.
# Atomic writes of user data; its device-run reach is the settings store a level run saves.
# ── unexercised: device-facing, but no online spec reaches it ──
# ── deps: the Rust dependency set (hidapi, cpal and tauri ride it) ──
# ── none, made explicit: the side-by-side runner only orchestrates the two lanes ──
# ── offline-oracle files planned for later PRs (rows ahead of the files) ──
